componentsIntro: Every documented component, live and interactive.
footerNote: Open source under the MIT license. Built by the community, for the community.
demoDeleteBody: Deleting “Acme website” removes all its pages and members. This can’t be undone.
apiNoBinding: No generated Alpine binding found for {slug}.
apiNoOptions: This binding takes no options — mount it and it works.
apiBladeNoProps: This component takes no props — drop the tag in.
bladeInheritsAlpine: The behavior comes from {binding}() — install @lyra-ds/alpine and see the HTML + Alpine tab.
consentBody: This site keeps your theme choice in your browser. You can also allow anonymous usage analytics, which would only ever tell us which pages help people. Neither is needed to read anything here.
absenceReactMissing: This component has no React counterpart.
absenceReactToastStack: React renders the queue through ToastProvider instead of a standalone component.
absenceAlpineStatic: This component is static — it needs no Alpine binding. The plain HTML is all there is.
absenceAlpineCalendarView: Deferred by decision — CalendarView has no Alpine binding yet.
absenceBladeThemeProvider: Blade has no provider shape. The theme lives in the @lyraThemeScript directive plus the Alpine theme store.
absenceBladeCalendarView: Deferred by decision — CalendarView has no Blade counterpart yet.
absenceHtmlNever: This component has no canonical HTML of its own.
supportMissingCss: Documented semantic markup and CSS baseline
supportMissingBladeV1Contract: A recorded Blade compatibility update for the v1 contract
supportReasonBladeDownstream: Blade is a downstream released artifact and has no v1 compatibility record yet.
supportImpactReact: Do not rely on this component through React.
supportImpactCss: Do not rely on this component without a JavaScript adapter.
supportImpactAlpine: Do not rely on the Alpine interaction for this component.
supportImpactBlade: Do not rely on the released Blade artifact for v1 parity.
supportFallbackReact: Use the documented React adapter where it is available.
supportFallbackCssAlpine: Use the documented CSS or Alpine-enhanced alternative where it is available.
supportEvidenceChromiumOnly: The repository browser harness is Chromium-only; component-level v1 evidence is not recorded.
supportEvidenceNotRecorded: Evidence has not been recorded yet.
